DatabaseManager
The only class that enables communication between the application and the MySQL database.

Enum used for various returns in functions, mostly when checking constraints in the database.

The class that enables communication between the application and the H2 database.

Enum used for various returns in functions, mostly when checking constraints in the database.

A panel that descends (hierarchy wise) from the GUI panel, which means it can make a direct call to the main GUI panel, which itself can call the database manager.
DiscountPanel
The panel used by the administrator to start a discount on a collection of products.
GUI
The object managing all the interactions between the user and the application and the only point in the graphic part of the application to communicate with the database manager.
LoginPanel

MainAdminPanel
The main panel of the administrator UI containing the menu bar from which all management functionalities are available.
MainCustomerPanel

The menu panel used by the customer to switch the current panel to a variety of panels.

An enumeration containing identifiers for different classes of panels.
